subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owners (VPC, IP allowlist, SSO, KMS)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@gridworks.com>, GridWorks SE <se-eng@gridworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owners (VPC, IP allowlist, SSO, KMS)

Thanks for the call earlier today — quick recap and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone we discussed for the POC environment. I captured the items that will unblock the POC and flagged suggested owners and dependencies. Please review and confirm owners/timing so we can lock the pilot start date.

High-level target:
- POC kickoff window: 2027-05-03 — target close date for MAP milestone: 2027-05-14

Milestone: POC environment readiness (network + auth + secrets)
- VPC peering: GridWorks networking to initiate peering request. Owner (suggested): GridWorks network ops (Ethan). Dependency: firewall rules and CIDR verification. Estimated lead time: 3 business days once peering request submitted.
- IP allowlists: GridWorks to provide outbound allowlist ranges for control plane and egress. Owner: GridWorks security. Dependency: internal change window.
- SSO/SAML: We will provide SAML metadata and ACS/EntityID. Owner (Redwood): Jasmine Liu. Dependency: GridWorks IdP admin to accept and push assertion tests.
- Secrets/KMS: Decide KMS path (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed). Owner: Karthik Iyer to scope integration options; GridWorks security to confirm KMS policy. Dependency: KMS key policy and service account access.

Attachments: draft MAP spreadsheet + network diagram are attached for you to edit: MAP-draft-GridWorks-GW-2026-452.xlsx, network-diagram-vpc-peering.png

Immediate asks:
1) Ethan — can you confirm who on your side will submit the peering request and the CIDR range used for the peering?
2) Please upload the allowlist ranges to the shared Drive folder (link below) or reply with ranges in your next email.
3) GridWorks IdP: do you need our SAML metadata or a test SP endpoint first? Jasmine will coordinate once you confirm.
4) Karthik will follow up with a short options note (customer KMS vs Redwood KMS) — please flag any procurement requirements.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3GridWorks-MAP (MAP draft)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23456/GW-2026-452

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment stubs: MAP-draft-GridWorks-GW-2026-452.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-diagram-vpc-peering.png (PNG)
From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@gridworks.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: GridWorks SE <se-eng@gridworks.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owners (VPC, IP allowlist, SSO, KMS)

Thanks Priya — good notes. Quick responses below and a rough timeline from our side.

1) VPC peering: I will own initiating the peering request. Our network team needs the peer CIDR for the Redwood side and the exact peering diagram. I downloaded your diagram and will share it with our infra lead.
2) IP allowlists: see attached CSV (network-contacts-v1.csv) with current egress ranges we can provide immediately. We have a 24–48 hour change window once rules are raised.
3) SSO/SAML: we'd prefer to receive SAML metadata XML and an SP test endpoint; our IdP admin will configure and run an assertion test.
4) KMS: we are evaluating using our existing AWS KMS CMK. Can your team document the required IAM role and access pattern for Redwood? Also, we have an HSM-backed KMS requirement for production — will that be compatible with the POC?

Tentative timeline from our side:
- 2027-04-20: peering request and allowlist ticket submitted internally
- 2027-04-22: SAML metadata applied in IdP and initial assertion test
- 2027-05-03: POC environment validation session (tentative)

I copied our SE alias for visibility. We can update the MAP spreadsheet directly if you prefer.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Morris
Platform Lead, GridWorks
ethan.morris@gridworks.com | +1 617-555-0199

Attachment stubs: network-contacts-v1.csv (CSV)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owners (VPC, IP allowlist, SSO, KMS)

Priya —

Thanks for the recap and Ethan for the quick reply. A couple internal notes before we push the updated MAP back to GridWorks:
- I'll draft the KMS integration options today: (1) Redwood-managed KMS with customer CMK wrapping, (2) customer-managed AWS KMS key with cross-account IAM role, (3) bring-your-own-HSM option (longer lead time). Need to know GridWorks' procurement constraints for option (2) and (3).
- Security review: we should attach the truncated SOC2 evidence pack (A/C only) as part of the MAP deliverables. Jasmine, please add the SAML metadata template and a short checklist for IdP config.
- Owners: we should assign explicit owners in the MAP (Ethan for peering, GridWorks security for allowlists, Jasmine for SAML steps, Karthik for KMS scoping). I'll make those owner columns and push a new version to the Drive.

Once I update the spreadsheet I'll flag items that require legal or procurement support (doc templates, NDA/PO number).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@gridworks.com>, GridWorks SE <se-eng@gridworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: POC environment dependencies & owners (VPC, IP allowlist, SSO, KMS) — updated MAP attached

Ethan — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the ranges. I updated the MAP in Drive with explicit owners, target dates, and the short KMS options note Karthik proposed. Key updates:

- Owners assigned: Ethan (GridWorks) — VPC peering submit + CIDR confirmation; GridWorks security — IP allowlists; Jasmine (Redwood) — SSO/SAML metadata + test SP; Karthik (Redwood) — KMS integration options and IAM template.
- Target dates: peering/allowlist ticket by 2027-04-20; SAML test by 2027-04-22; POC validation session 2027-05-03; MAP milestone close 2027-05-14.
- Security: attaching our truncated SOC2 evidence summary and SAML checklist (see Drive). We'll mark any required legal/procurement steps in the MAP and surface them in the next call.

Next steps:
1) Ethan — please confirm the peering submission has been placed and paste the ticket number in the MAP row for VPC peering.
2) GridWorks SE — please confirm the IdP admin who will run assertion tests and the preferred time window for 2027-04-22.
3) I'll schedule the 60-minute POC validation session for 2027-05-03 and send a calendar invite once we have the peering ticket in place.

Links: MAP updated (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3GridWorks-MAP
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23456/GW-2026-452

If it's helpful I can also send a short one-page MAP summary to your procurement contact for faster approvals.

Best,
Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
